description: Get one video's status and details by id. While rendering, status is PENDING/GENERATING_*/RENDERING with estimatedCompletionTime. A PENDING video that cannot render returns blockedReason (e.g. INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS) with creditsNeeded, creditsAvailable and topUpUrl: stop polling and resolve it. COMPLETED returns a playable videoUrl; FAILED returns error, and for an image-to-video clip also errorCode: why it failed, as a code (CONTENT_POLICY, TIMEOUT, PROVIDER_FAILED, OUTPUT_CHECK, OUTPUT_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE, REFUSAL_LIMIT, TRIAL_LIMIT, USER_DAILY_CAP, DAILY_CAP, NOT_PAID, IMAGE_NOT_SCREENED, OPTIONS_UNREADABLE, OPTION_SWITCHED_OFF, INTERNAL_ERROR). Image-to-video clips also return aspectRatio and imageToVideo{aspectRatio, aspectRatioSource, inputWidth, inputHeight, cropped, outputWidth, outputHeight}; width and height (measured from the file) appear once COMPLETED. Free. Motion clips (autoshort_generate_motion_clip) also return motionClip{promptSent, seed, resolution, seconds, credits}, and on failure errorCode and creditsRefunded.

id.description: Video id (a director draftId works too). Every create tool returns it as `id` (also as `videoId`).

videoId.description: Alias of `id`: the name the create tools use in their answer. Send either one.

name: autoshort_get_video
title: Get a video
